summary: The operator surface gets a seam: one read contract (`lib/operator/read.ts`), one enumeration (`lib/operator/routes.ts`: 23 pages, 7 write modules), and a test that forbids an operator file importing the product shell.
reader_impact: No screen changes — the same screens with the same geometry; what moves is that operator tooling can now change without editing the user platform, and a new coupling fails a test.
